gloss: pearly white; pearl color; mother-of-pearl sheen

definitions.gloss: pearly white; the iridescent color of a pearl
definitions.explanation: A soft, slightly silvery white with a faint opalescent or iridescent sheen, like the surface of a real pearl. Used in writing about cosmetics, fashion, cars, and nature to describe any object with that characteristic subtle, lustrous glow.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧ (pearl) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). Describes a luminous, soft white with a delicate shimmer — the kind of look aimed at in pearlescent cosmetics, car paint, and evening wear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: pearly-white skin — used in cosmetics marketing
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光沢|こうたく}→光沢：14844_koutaku⟧: pearly luster / iridescent sheen
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine with a pearly glow
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネイル→ネイル：25891_neiru⟧: pearly-white nail polish
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧: pearlescent paint finish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乳白色|にゅうはくしょく}: milky white — a similar soft white, but opaque rather than iridescent.
- ⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧: silver — much brighter and more metallic; lacks the soft iridescence of {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}.
- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧: white — the plain, unqualified word; {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} suggests a specific refined shade.
- パールホワイト: pearl white — a loanword equivalent common in cosmetics and car paint descriptions; nearly synonymous in practice.
- ⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧ホワイト: off-white — a warm or slightly yellowish white, not necessarily iridescent.

USAGE:
You will see {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} most often in descriptive writing — novels, ad copy, and reviews — rather than in everyday conversation. In spoken language, パールホワイト or simply ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ is more common; {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} carries a slightly poetic or refined tone.
